api.outputs: DiagnosticResult.metrics is an immutable FrozenMap; to_dict includes provenance, actual publication, uncalibrated inference and ZERO capital authority.
api.publication_contract: Caller supplies actual publication >= cutoff; the production adapter must stamp publication after computation and bind source publication evidence.
api.value_semantics: Caller-supplied levels, with no implicit log or price transformation.

bounds_and_causality.availability: Each leg actual availability must be >= observation timestamp and <= information cutoff; future rows are rejected, not silently filtered.
bounds_and_causality.cadence: Strictly increasing equally spaced synchronized observation timestamps.
bounds_and_causality.identity: Input identity binds method, version, cutoff, timestamps, availability, values, references and explicit parameters.
bounds_and_causality.input_references: Each supplied source reference must be a canonical lowercase SHA256 digest.
bounds_and_causality.kalman: Forward random-walk alpha/beta filter with fixed caller variance assumptions and Joseph covariance update; no backward smoothing.
bounds_and_causality.unsupported_or_missing: NOT_ESTIMABLE with a reason and empty metrics; no guessed estimates.

inference_limits.calibration: No published calibration is bound to this API. No universal ADF cutoff, Student-t p value, ordinary ADF residual p value or Johansen critical table is fabricated.

integration: Root reports integration into zero-authority S8 sidecar with last 720 prior synchronized log-price observations and publication sampled after each calculation. Runtime integration validation belongs to the root workstream; this handoff claims focused API evidence only.

mathematics.adf: OLS of delta y_t on y_(t-1), optional constant and explicitly fixed lagged differences; rho/standard_error is reported.
mathematics.engle_granger: A-on-B OLS with intercept, followed by residual ADF without deterministic terms; Engle-Granger distribution is explicitly distinct from ordinary ADF.
mathematics.half_life: Intercept AR1 fit; -log(2)/log(phi) observation half-life, scaled by cadence. Phi must be strictly within (1e-10, 1-1e-10). OU interpretation remains a hypothesis.
mathematics.johansen_vecm: Partial out fixed lagged differences; solve (S10 S00^-1 S01) beta=lambda S11 beta, normalize beta_A=1, and fit alpha and gamma. Trace/max-eigen statistics are uncalibrated.
mathematics.numeric_policy: Reject design singular-value ratio <=1e-10, covariance eigenvalue ratio <=1e-10, zero residual variance, unidentifiable eigenvectors and degenerate canonical correlations.
mathematics.rank_profile: Two legs, caller-assumed rank one, no deterministic terms. Full rank covariance/error matrices and a distinct leading eigenvalue are required. Unsupported rank and deterministic profiles fail closed.
